title: SolarPlugin
description: A solar system PvP experience where players are assigned to a planet, each with unique abilities powered by a gem that grows stronger with every kill.
body:
# 🌌 SolarPlugin — Solar System PvP

Players are randomly assigned to a planet when they join. Each planet has unique passive and active abilities powered by a gem system.

## 💎 Gem System
Your gem level determines the strength of your abilities. Kill players to upgrade your gem, but beware — dying will damage it!

- ⚡ **Energised** — Maximum power
- 💚 **Intact** — Full abilities
- 💛 **Small Cracks** — Basic abilities
- 🔴 **Big Cracks** — Weakened abilities
- 💀 **Shattered** — No abilities

## 🪐 Planets
- **Mercury** — Speed & slowness
- **Venus** — Fire & flame (bypasses Fire Resistance!)
- **Earth** — Healing & regeneration
- **Mars** — Strength & shockwaves
- **Saturn** — Poison & blindness
- **Jupiter** — Magnetism & repulsion
- **Uranus** — Ice & freezing
- **Neptune** — Wind & tornadoes

## ⚙️ Fully Configurable
- Cooldowns per planet
- Ability radius, damage and duration
- Gem upgrade/downgrade settings
- Scoreboard title and server name
- All messages

## 📋 Requirements
- Paper 1.21.11
- Java 21
